description: Mara, a freelance photographer, has one Sunday morning portrait-session slot available and must decide whether to accept a neighbor's proposed arrangement, then settle the session's exact terms after hearing from the neighbor and a friend familiar with the proposed park.

shared_context.S1: Mara has one Sunday morning portrait-session slot available.
shared_context.S2: Evan has asked about booking an outdoor family portrait session at Riverside Park.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the final decision about whether to accept the arrangement and what terms to agree to.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing an informal booking, Mara routinely asks the people present to state any terms, practical constraints, or relevant details they know.

PF1.text: Evan's concrete proposal is $180 for the session, 20 edited digital photographs, and the shoot on Sunday, September 15, from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.; he will pay in cash at the session.

PF2.text: Rosa spoke with a Riverside Park caretaker yesterday, who told her that portrait photography on September 15 is permitted only in the Rose Garden and requires a $25 day permit; Rosa has not yet shared this with Mara or Evan.

acceptance_conditions: Mara must accept Evan as the client.
The agreed session price must be exactly $180.
The agreement must provide exactly 20 edited digital photographs.
The shoot must be scheduled for Sunday, September 15, from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.
The shoot location must be the Rose Garden at Riverside Park.
The $25 day permit must be reimbursed as part of the arrangement.
The permit reimbursement must be recorded as an informal commitment.
Rosa's park information must be cited as justification for the location and permit terms.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'permit_reimbursement' and c['target'] == 'Evan' and c['detail'] == '$25 day permit' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Evan's proposal changes the booking from an unspecified inquiry to Evan at exactly $180 for exactly 20 edited photographs on September 15 from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.
Rosa's caretaker-sourced information changes the location to the Rose Garden and adds an exact $25 permit reimbursement and commitment that are otherwise absent.
